plugins.name: code-nav
plugins.description: Code navigation, definition, reference, implementation, trace, and AST-grep fork for OMP.
plugins.attribution: Forked from pi-code-nav. Ported to OMP 17.2.1 by ezxomp.

plugins.name: codesight
plugins.description: CodeSight artifact reader, session-owned watcher, overlay, and plugin settings fork for OMP.
plugins.attribution: Forked from pi-codesight. Ported to OMP 17.2.1 by ezxomp.

plugins.name: experiences
plugins.description: Experience capture, retrieval, selection, consolidation, scheduling, and CLI fork for OMP.
plugins.attribution: Forked from pi-experiences. Ported to OMP 17.2.1 by ezxomp.

plugins.name: agent-learning
plugins.description: Unified agent learning for OMP — ezxomp plugin/tool catalog + skills.sh surface (safe-language policy), native-memory facts shim, skillforge evidence/procedures pipeline with human-gated patches, habits lane via @ezxomp/experiences, optional learning.review gate.
plugins.attribution: ezxomp original — consolidates the skills, skillforge, and experiences lanes (doc-5).

plugins.name: compact-eng
plugins.description: Compact Engineering governor and observer for OMP-native Shake, text compaction, and snapcompact.
plugins.attribution: Originated as Vendex pi-ultra-compact; renamed and substantially rearchitected by ezxomp around OMP-native composition.

plugins.name: extensible-workflows
plugins.description: Saved-recipe persistence and authoring layer for OMP native Workflowz. Catalog, validate, store, and render.
plugins.attribution: Forked from vekexasia/pi-extensible-workflows by Vekexasia. Recast for OMP 17.2.1 by ezxomp.

plugins.name: augment
plugins.description: Augment-style prompt rewriting with persisted OMP settings and editor review.
plugins.attribution: Forked from pi-augment by sting8k. Ported to OMP 17.2.1 by ezxomp.

plugins.name: plannotator
plugins.description: Planning, annotation, code/PR review, browser server, and saved-state restoration fork for OMP.
plugins.attribution: Forked from backnotprop/plannotator by Backnotprop. Ported to OMP 17.2.1 by ezxomp.

plugins.name: evo
plugins.description: OMP extension: evo mode toggle. Restricts the main agent and/or subagents to a marketplace-plugin tool set (every registered tool incl. all marketplace-plugin tools, eval-first; read for protocol URIs only; blocks native write/bash/edit/glob/grep).
plugins.attribution: Forked from pi-evo-mode. Ported to OMP 17.2.1 by ezxomp.

plugins.name: cook
plugins.description: Backlog.md cookbook workflow plugin for OMP. Decomposes work into atomic sub-tickets and drives scout/planner/worker/validator/judge plus conditional audit/refute agents through OMP's native task tool, with ADHD divergent ideation, DAG iteration, and Done-gate enforcement.
plugins.attribution: Forked from pi-backlog-cook. Ported to OMP 17.2.1 by ezxomp.

plugins.name: backlog
plugins.description: Backlog.md integration plugin for OMP. Registers the backlog_* tool suite over the backlog CLI and injects the canonical Backlog.md workflow instructions as the default system-prompt overlay for all agent work.
plugins.attribution: Born in ezxomp; tools extracted from @ezxomp/cook.

plugins.name: pstack-suite
plugins.description: Unified agent workflow command suite: code quality, PR review, docs, CI, team ops. The alternative workflow to the Backlog.md cookbook.

plugins.name: gsd-web
plugins.description: OMP-native port of the GSD-Pi Web UI: Next.js 16 standalone dashboard with /gsd-web command, gsd_web_* tools, and an omp --mode rpc bridge.
plugins.attribution: Ported from open-gsd/gsd-pi web UI. Ported to OMP 18.0.6 by ezxomp.

plugins.name: gsd-browser
plugins.description: GSD browser-tool surface for OMP: page fetch, Brave web search, DOM snapshot, navigation, and screenshots with GSD's honest-degradation reason codes.

plugins.name: gsd-loop
plugins.description: Autonomous GSD loop kernel for OMP (port of gsd-pi auto-mode loop).
plugins.attribution: Born in repo. Kernel-semantics port of gsd-pi auto-mode loop.

plugins.name: gsd-graph
plugins.description: GSD knowledge graph and workflow execution graph (GRAPH.yaml engine) for OMP, ported from gsd-pi.
plugins.attribution: Port of gsd-pi graph subsystems (workflow GRAPH.yaml engine + TS-native knowledge graph) to OMP.

plugins.name: better-custom
plugins.description: Typed /custom-provider wizard for adding, editing, and deleting custom model providers through native OMP UI, with an authenticated model browser registered in the /model seam.
